lines.en: This is unbelievable, Pheebs. How can you be married?
Well, I mean, I'm not married married, you know?
He was just a friend, and he's gay, and he was from Canada,
and he just needed a green card.
I can't believe you married Duncan.
I mean, how could you not tell me?
We lived together, we told each other everything.
I'm sorry, Monica, but I know if I told you,
you'd get really, like, judgmental, and you would not approve.
I mean, you were totally in love with this guy who, hello, was gay.
I mean, what the hell were you thinking?
See, and you thought she'd be judgmental.
Okay, I wasn't in love with him, and I was just helping out a friend.
Please, when he left town, you stayed in your pajamas for a month.
And I saw you eat a cheeseburger.
I'm going to go meet Duncan.
He's skating tonight at the garden.
Yeah, the turns aren't as fast, but when Snoopy falls, funny.
I can't believe you're dressing up for him.
I mean, you're just, you're setting yourself up all over again.
For your information, I'm going to see him so I can put all those feelings behind me.
Okay, and the reason I'm dressed like this is because I think it's nice to look nice for your gay husband.
You came to see me yesterday.
I kind of need a divorce.
Um, actually, I'm getting married again.
Oh, God, I don't know how to tell you this.
I, I don't, I don't understand.
I mean, you're, you're so smart and funny,
and you throw such great Academy Award parties, you know?
That's what I kept telling myself,
but you just reach a point where you can't live a lie anymore.
So how long have you known?
Well, I guess on some level, I always knew I was straight, but...
I thought I was supposed to be something else.
You know, I'm an ice dancer.
I was just trying to fit in, you know?
and there's actually a, a woman.
Well, is she, is she the first that you've been with?
Well, I've never told you this,
but there were one or two times
and go to a straight bar
and wake up with a woman next to me.
But I, I, I told myself it was the liquor
But now I know I don't have a choice about this.
I, I, I don't know what to say.
you're married to someone for six years
and you think you know him
and then one day he says,
Um, have you told your parents?
I just have one more question.
Um, if you had figured this out sooner
and, um, I had been around,
do you think that I would have been the one who?
